svg.title: Common prefix and free running generation comparison modes
svg.desc: The prefix controlled mode supplies an identical history to full recomputation and cached suffix computation and compares every suffix logit row. Free running paths each follow their own selected IDs. At the first divergence retain both histories and replay the common prefix. Later logits on different inputs are not a conditional cache error comparison.
svg.text: Two comparison modes answer different correctness questions
Prefix-controlled: supply the same exact history to both paths
Full recomputation of prefix → reference suffix logits
Cached old prefix + new suffix → compare every corresponding row
Free-running: each path follows its own selected IDs
Compare shared-prefix logits, IDs, stable text and terminal state.
First unequal selection → preserve both histories and the common prefix.
After divergence, later logits describe different inputs
Replay the first shared-prefix failure; do not call later differences cache error.
Freeze model, vocabulary, positions, masks, request identity and output policy first.
